caption: The drawing features a single object: a bonnet depicted in a three-quarters view, facing left. The bonnet is light in color, predominantly beige or off-white, and displays intricate patterns made up of small, repeating black or dark gray marks arranged in horizontal and vertical rows. The front edge and sides of the bonnet show gathered or ruched fabric details, and two long, narrow straps hang downward from the lower edge, intended to tie under the chin. The background is plain and unadorned, with the object positioned slightly to the right of center. The artist’s signature, "V. Bergé," is inscribed to the right of the bonnet.
title: Woman's Night Cap
